Descriptions

The 80*40*160cm glass display cabinet is the perfect choice to display your collectibles, display items, or treasures in style. With its elegant design and functional features, this display cabinet is an eye-catcher in any room. The white high-quality wood cabinet gives the cabinet a modern and timeless look, while the brown glass doors and sides add a touch of elegance and sophistication. The double cabinet doors open effortlessly for easy access to the display pieces. The integrated LED lighting makes your collectibles shine and creates atmospheric lighting that puts your objects in the right light. Whether for a special presentation or just for decoration, LED lighting offers versatile options for customization to suit your needs. Inside the display cabinet there are three levels of shelving, of which the middle one is permanently mounted, while the upper and lower levels are individually adjustable. This allows you to adjust the height of the shelves to the size of your display pieces and make the most of the available space. Whether for displaying collectibles, jewelry, model cars, or other valuable items, this glass display cabinet is the ideal choice for those who value style, quality, and functionality.
